title: [C16T1] Percentage of households with electrical appliances
prompt: The charts show the changes in ownership of electrical appliances and amount of time spent doing housework in households in one country between 1920 and 2019. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graphs illustrate the percentage of households owning three different electrical appliances and the weekly hours spent on housework in a particular country over a 99-year period, from 1920 to 2019.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the ownership of all three household appliances witnessed a significant upward trend throughout the given period, with refrigerators and vacuum cleaners ultimately becoming standard equipment in virtually all households. Conversely, In contrast, the weekly hours dedicated to housework declined substantially over the same timeframe.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the electrical appliances, in 1920, washing machines were the most common, being present in about 40% of households, while refrigerators and vacuum cleaners were less prevalent, at approximately 3% and 30% respectively. Refrigerator ownership then rose dramatically to nearly 100% by 1980, maintaining this level until 2019. Similarly, vacuum cleaner usage showed a steady increase, reaching around 70% by 1960 and eventually matching refrigerator ownership by the end of the period. The proportion of homes with washing machines grew more modestly, rising to about 70% by 1960 and remaining relatively stable thereafter.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding housework hours, households in 1920 spent approximately 50 hours per week on tasks such as washing clothes, preparing meals, and cleaning. This figure decreased steadily over the following decades, falling to about 35 hours in 1940 and 20 hours by 1960. The downward trend continued, albeit more gradually, with weekly housework hours dropping to roughly 15 hours in 1980 and finally reaching about 10 hours in 2019.
